title: Kaaviya Thalaivan
desc: Two rival artists at Sivadas Swamigal's drama troupe compete in everything they do. While one of them goes on to become successful, the other fails in life.

title: Romeo
desc: Arivu desires a real love connection but ends up with Leela, who marries him out of family obligation. However, despite their differences, he tries his best to win her over.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.

title: Mookuthi Amman
desc: The life of struggling news anchor, Engels Ramaswamy, and his family changes when a goddess appears before them. Later, with the help of the goddess, Engels sets out to expose fake godmen.

title: Anjani Putra
desc: A businessman saves a policeman from a group of thugs. As a result, he incurs the wrath of a ruthless local gangster who is also an assassin.

title: Balakrishna
desc: A money-minded local goon is hired to protect a woman from her family's rivals. However, he, initially, only accepts the job for the money but later falls in love with her.

title: Tej I Love You
desc: Tej, a young man, gets banished from his family for breaking his sister's marriage. He moves to London where he falls in love with a beautiful girl, Nandini.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
